explanation_excerpt: Skills in this pack follow the agentskills.io spec, which makes them portable across every supported platform — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Kimi, Zed, Cursor, and MiniMax — not just Claude Code. The pack's core skills run entirely

gaps.description: Factual error: claims the two local MCP servers only reach out when a skill's instructions explicitly call for external search. The corpus states these MCP servers are local services that do not themselves perform external search — internet is required only for skills that explicitly perform web research.
gaps.corpus_ref: MISCONCEPTION: the pack requires internet to function

gaps.description: Missing coverage of required SKILL.md frontmatter fields and validate vs validate:strict distinction, the full skill domain list, imported skills as Git submodules, the fuller MCP server roster, and hooks/hooks.json canonical-source-vs-symlink handling.

transfer_problems: A contributor adds a new skill directory under skills/devops/ with a SKILL.md missing the metadata.tags field, then runs npm run validate (not validate:strict) before submission. Explain whether this will catch the omission, and why the correct validation command matters here.

A teammate edits a file directly inside .claude-plugin/skills/some-skill/SKILL.md instead of under skills/some-skill/SKILL.md, believing both locations are independent copies. Explain what actually happens to the file and why, referencing how .claude-plugin/ relates to skills/.
